description: Use this to resolve payload fields for one currently WAITING wake-up target. It reads XRC-729.getOSTC(step -> XRC-137) and XRC-137.getRule() via eth_call for plain JSON rules. Encrypted rules are not decrypted server-side.

address.description: EVM wallet, Safe or contract address in 0x-prefixed hexadecimal format.

owner.description: EVM address of the XDaLa session owner or relevant account.

pid.description: XDaLa process id within a session tree.

sessionId.description: XDaLa session identifier used to query runtime or explorer data.

step.description: Human-readable XDaLa step label or step identifier.

name: resolve_wakeup_payload_schema

data.description: Structured result data returned by the XGR MCP gateway.

title: Resolve XDaLa wake-up payload schema
